title: Hold WHS accreditation to build for the Commonwealth
what: The rules set up a WHS Accreditation Scheme for builders who wish to carry out building work funded by the Commonwealth.

sources.title: Federal Safety Commissioner Act 2022
sources.quote: 43 WHS Accreditation Scheme for Commonwealth building work Accreditation scheme (1) The rules may prescribe an accreditation scheme, to be known as the Work Health and Safety Accreditation Scheme, for persons who wish to carry out building work funded by the Commonwealth or a corporate Commonwealth entity.

reach.condition: if it contracts for Commonwealth-funded building work covered by the scheme
